skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with 2 consecutive hits dealing 60% ATK DMG each; on a critical hit, has a 100% chance to inflict [Corrode] on the main target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 15% ATK).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes each enemy in the entire row with 5 consecutive hits dealing 26% ATK DMG each, has a 100% chance to inflict [Corrode] on the main target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 20% ATK), and enemies that are critically hit have a 100% chance to take [Corrode] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes each enemy in the entire row with 5 consecutive hits dealing 33% ATK DMG each, has a 100% chance to inflict [Corrode] on the main target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 30% ATK), and enemies that are critically hit have a 100% chance to take [Corrode] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Each enemy on the field afflicted with [Corrode] raises the ATK of all allies by 10%, stacking up to 3 times.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Each enemy on the field afflicted with [Corrode] raises the ATK of all allies by 15%, stacking up to 3 times.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Each enemy on the field afflicted with [Corrode] raises the ATK of all allies by 18%, stacking up to 3 times.

effects.desc: Corrosive damage over time effect, each turn dealing damage equal to a percentage of ST (e.g. 300%) to the target.
